# Pull Request

## Summary

Data change for IronClaude issue 488: `ccsession-models.json` gains `tier2b` (new gateway alias `claude-gw-tier2b`), `tier3` shrinks to two slots, `tier4` grows to three. The models and windows live in the Coder env file (Coder PR 495, central defaults release `20261110-1`); this PR is the data that names them.

**DO NOT MERGE to `master` until Coder central defaults `20261110-1` is installed in every workspace, running and stopped.** Every launch fetches this JSON from `master`. In tier mode a launch stops when a slot the JSON names is unset ("T2bModel01 is not set (needed by tier2b)"). A regression test pins that failure. Merging into `346Claude-integration` is safe; the hazard is `integration` -> `master`.

## Changes

- `ccsession-models.json` (2026-11-11.1): `tier2b` = `T2bModel01`-`T2bModel04` (GPT-6.1 Terra, GLM-5.3, Qwen3.8 Max, Muse Wonder 1.0), between tier2 and tier3. `tier3` = `T3Model01`-`T3Model02` (GLM-5.3, Qwen3.8 Max). `tier4` = `T4Model01`-`T4Model03` (GPT-6 Luna, Claude Haiku 5.5, Grok 4.7). Adds display name "Claude Haiku 5.5".
- `MODEL-TIERS.md`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`: tier tables, windows (900K / 900K / 500K), merge-order warning.
- `tests/unit/test_ccsession_tiers.py`: fixture updated to the 20261110-1 layout. New tests pin the shipped tier order and slots, the missing-`T2bModel01` error on an old workspace env, and that a tier rule naming `tier2b` needs it defined.

Not in this PR (open in issue 488): `issue-worker-t3` pin, `haiku` alias, the retry-ladder rung that reads `T3Model01`, historical design docs, gateway id verification, and Coder release B (add `tier2b` to the member rule, drop `T3Model03`-`T3Model06`).

Refs #488

```bash
uv run pytest tests/unit/test_ccsession_tiers.py tests/unit/test_ccsession_tag.py tests/unit/test_install_ccsession.py -q
```
